svg.aria-label: Where to read first. doctor saying WSL cannot compact leads to this WSL cannot compact; a run of a disk cut off at compact, to The window closed during a run; a filesystem that records errors, to the filesystem records errors. The screen saying Docker Desktop's disk is in use leads to Docker Desktop's disk is in use. shrink saying another run is not finished leads to another run is not finished, and a disk that uses less after compacting than before, beyond what was cleaned, to more went than was cleaned.
